payload.summary: Planned an independent, human-focused decision choices ledger: a read-only auditor pass reconstructing implementation-time decisions from git history and session artifacts, emitting choices.json/choices.md ranked least-confident first. Approach 1 (new artifact + standalone audit-choices skill + non-blocking workflow hooks) selected at Gate 1; discovery fixed invocation (both standalone and hooked), format (md + JSON sidecar), decision-index relationship (cross-reference only), and escalation (needs-user surfaces at existing gates).

decisions.title: Separate decision-choices schema instead of extending review-findings
decisions.rationale: review-findings validator hard-requires axis/severity and its consumers assume code-anchored defects; decision entries are intent-anchored. Follows validate-feature-findings-gate precedent.

decisions.title: choices.json is source of truth; choices.md rendered from it
decisions.rationale: Single writer makes the least-confident-first ranking and header requirements unit-testable; renderer is pure Python, preserving the host-assisted invariant.

decisions.title: Cross-reference-only linkage to self-reported decisions, never write-back
decisions.rationale: Positions the ledger as the audit counterpart to the self-reported docs/decisions archive; writing into session-log or docs/decisions would break the deterministic drift gates and the read-only auditor principle.

decisions.title: Audit never blocks; needs-user verdicts surface at existing gates
decisions.rationale: Auditor exits 0 always; validate-feature/cleanup-feature list open needs-user entries at their existing human gates, reusing the deferred-tasks surfacing pattern.

decisions.title: Copy codeviz artifact header field set from prioritize-proposals module
decisions.rationale: skills/shared/artifact_header.py does not exist yet; the prioritize-proposals module docstring sanctions verbatim reuse so the eventual shared-helper migration is a no-op.

next_steps: implement-feature add-decision-choices-ledger, starting with wp-contracts then wp-artifact-registration
